title: Signatures of Gravastars and Extra Dimensions in Gravitational Wave Observations
content: I explore anomalous structures in binary black hole (BBH) merger data from gravitational wave observations that suggest possible evidence for exotic compact objects—particularly Gravastars—formed under higher-dimensional physical laws. I conducted four independent Monte Carlo simulations testing deviations from general relativity (GR) predictions in mass distributions, spin misalignment, polarization variability, and redshift-based merger rates. The results indicate systematic, non-random behavior consistent with signatures of extra dimensions, negative energy density, and potentially even wormhole-connected or hierarchical compact object evolution.
